### 1 — Scene
A rice-and-meat dish in a thick brown curry-style sauce, with a separate bowl of cooked mixed vegetables. The meat type is uncertain. Water contributes no food energy.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 24 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12² = **452 cm²**.
- **Vegetable bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are rice, meat pieces, brown sauce, carrots, sweetcorn, and broccoli. No separate oil or dressing is clearly distinguishable; any cooking fat is included in the sauce estimate.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
The rice, meat, and sauce are intermingled, so their area shares are approximate allocations without double-counting.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 38% of main plate | 172 × 1.8 = 310 ml | 0.8 | 248 g | 130 | 322 kcal |
| Cooked meat pieces | 17% | 77 × 1.8 = 139 ml | 0.95 | 132 g | 190 | 251 kcal |
| Brown curry-style sauce | 15% | 68 × 0.9 = 61 ml | 1.0 | 61 g | 100 | 61 kcal |
| Cooked carrots | 23% of bowl | 72 × 1.3 = 94 ml | 0.6 | 56 g | 35 | 20 kcal |
| Sweetcorn | 20% | 63 × 1.2 = 76 ml | 0.65 | 49 g | 90 | 44 kcal |
| Broccoli | 7% | 22 × 2.5 = 55 ml | 0.6 | 33 g | 35 | 12 kcal |

**Coverage check:** Main plate allocations total **70%**; vegetable bowl allocations total **50%**, consistent with the visible portions and empty rims.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **441 g for the main dish** and **138 g of vegetables**, totaling approximately **579 g and 710 kcal**. This is plausible for the substantial main-dish mound and modest vegetable serving. Sauce richness and meat identity are the largest energy uncertainties.
